## ColorPrefSource type

Identifies the source that set a color preference value. Determines whether an incoming change (e.g. from a mode or system event) is allowed to override the current value.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type ColorPrefSource = 'default' | 'chartDefault' | 'modeDefault' | 'profile' | 'system' | 'user';
```
